categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label and fixes intermittent timeouts and test flakiness in the interface_ipc_mining functional test on slow hosts.
categories.rationale: Prevents intermittent test timeouts by lengthening event-wait limits on slow test hosts. As noted in the description, default 1-second timeouts cause races when events are delayed, which ryanofsky confirmed is resolved by using the longer timeout constant.
